backlog.title: Remediate end-to-end validation defects (BUG-001..BUG-005)
backlog.description: Fix the five issues found by end-to-end validation of the pi-file-injector extension against its PRD: one Major display bug (expanded chat view body misalignment after a paged file, BUG-001) and four Minor robustness/spec-parity issues (markdown-level malformed ranges silent + raw-token leak BUG-002; empty-body URL image attaches empty ImageContent BUG-003; autocomplete remap mangles non-@ values BUG-004; ftp:// scheme dropped from the URL shape gate BUG-005). All fixes are confined to file-injector.ts (1932 lines, single-file extension) plus its 4 standalone .mjs test harnesses, README.md, and spec/. Hard invariants (see plan/011_e473dac8178b/bugfix/001_a6ffb98ab096/architecture/system_context.md): NO new exports (module-surface allowlist test at file-injector.test.mjs:141-155), model-facing message.content unchanged for correct cases, unique new test-case labels (existing BUG-001/BUG-002 labels refer to older bugs), every subtask ships failing-test-first then fix, npm test + npm run typecheck green as Definition of Done.

milestones.title: BUG-001: Expanded-view body pairing after paged files (Major)
milestones.description: Make the chat renderer's expanded view show the correct body for url/binary details that follow a paged file in the same prompt. Two-layer fix: (1) populate contentStart/contentLen for kind url (body-bearing block, same envelope as text) and kind binary (note-inner via a kind-gated no-newline branch) in computeDetailOffsets; (2) make the renderer's tier-3 regex fallback pair details to blocks by path instead of index, repairing old persisted messages too. Display-only: model-facing message.content must remain byte-identical.

tasks.title: Fix expanded chat-view body pairing after paged files (computeDetailOffsets + tier-3 fallback)
tasks.description: A paged file emits TWO <file> blocks (head + <paged:> directive) but ONE FileDetail. computeDetailOffsets (file-injector.ts:462-513, skip-guard at :475) only computes offsets for kind text/paged, so url/binary details fall to tier-3 bodies[i] (:1065-1067) which indexes BLOCKS while i indexes DETAILS — after a paged file the following URL shows the paged directive and the binary never shows its note. Fix both the offset producer (url + binary kinds) and the fallback consumer (path-aware pairing).

milestones.title: Minor robustness fixes: markdown malformed ranges (BUG-002) + empty URL images (BUG-003)
milestones.description: Two injection-path robustness fixes. BUG-002: injectMarkdown's Step-5 loop consumes scanTokens records without the invalidRange guard that the top-level processor has — a malformed range inside a delivered markdown file (e.g. #@a.md:0) silently verbatims (no LR-3 warning) and leaks the RAW token string into injectFile (process-cwd stat; relative block name if a literal colon-file exists). BUG-003: injectUrl's image branch lacks the F5 empty-body guard the local-file path has — a 200 image/* response with zero-length body attaches an empty ImageContent that providers reject.

tasks.title: BUG-002: Guard invalidRange records in injectMarkdown Step 5 (LR-3 parity + raw-token leak removal)
tasks.description: Mirror processTokenStream's LR-3 handling into injectMarkdown's Step-5 recursion loop: skip invalidRange records (before the claimKey re-check) and emit the byte-identical hasUI-guarded warning notify, so malformed ranges inside delivered markdown are no longer silent and the unresolved raw token never reaches injectFile.

subtasks.title: injectMarkdown Step-5: skip rec.invalidRange + emit LR-3 warning
subtasks.context_scope:

3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §Minor Issue 1 per its Recommendation: inside the Step-5 for-loop, first branch on rec.invalidRange — emit the same warning (hasUI-guarded, type "warning" — typecheck enforces the notify union) and continue; keep the existing claimKey/injectFile lines unchanged for valid records. subtasks.title: injectUrl image branch: empty body → formatEmptyImageBlock note, no attachment
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Read plan/011_e473dac8178b/bugfix/001_a6ffb98ab096/architecture/injection_bug002_003.md (§ BUG-003 injectUrl image path, § fix inputs (h) guard placement analysis). readBytesCapped (:861-878) returns an EMPTY Buffer (not null) for a zero-length body — null only on overflow — so the existing 'if (buf === null) return false;' (:923) never catches it; resizeImage deterministically returns null on empty bytes (photon throws → catch → null), so resized?.data ?? buf.toString("base64") === "" today. estimateImageTokens(null) === 2805 (IMAGE_FALLBACK_TOKENS :118) is the wrong cost for 0 bytes. The F5 local template (:1308-1323) pushes formatEmptyImageBlock + detail {path, kind:"image", dimensionHint: undefined} + subtract(ceil(len/4)) with no over-budget turn-away.
2. INPUT: res (Response) with content-type image/*; state (images, blocks, details, remaining, count); url string. formatEmptyImageBlock (:387-389) shape: '<file name="URL"><empty image file \u2014 0 bytes; nothing to attach></file>'.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §Minor Issue 2 per its Recommendation. Insert immediately AFTER 'if (buf === null) return false;' (:923) and BEFORE resizeImage (:925): if (buf.length === 0) → push formatEmptyImageBlock(url) to state.blocks, push { path: url, kind: "image", dimensionHint: undefined } to state.details, subtract(state, Math.ceil(f5Block.length / 4)), state.count++, return true. Placement rationale (mirror F5 exactly): before resizeImage avoids spawning the Worker for 0 bytes; before the guard-3 budget check gives F5 parity (the note always delivers; the ~15-20 token note cost is negligible). Mocking: tests stub globalThis.fetch (save/restore in try/finally, per-case) with makeRes({ ct: "image/png", body: "" }) from url-injection.test.mjs:143-167 — body:"" is the deterministic zero-length-chunk fixture. Do NOT stub resizeImage (external, jiti-aliased; relies on deterministic null-on-invalid). Failing test FIRST (label URL-IMG-EMPTY, near DIS-4 :346-360): injectFiles("#https://example.com/empty.png", [], FIX, false, true) → assert r.images.length === 0, hasBlock(r, '<file name="https://example.com/empty.png"><empty image file \u2014 0 bytes; nothing to attach></file>'), r.injected === 1, r.details[0].kind === "image". Keep DIS-4 green (non-empty body still attaches — images[0].data round-trips).
4. OUTPUT: empty-body URL images produce the note block + image detail, no ImageContent. Non-empty image URLs byte-identical to today. No exported surface change.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update README.md ### URLs Images bullet (:82): an image URL whose body is empty attaches a note ('empty image file — 0 bytes') instead of an image, same as a 0-byte local image. Rides WITH this subtask.

milestones.title: Spec & UX parity: autocomplete pass-through (BUG-004) + ftp scheme gate (BUG-005)
milestones.description: Two parity fixes. BUG-004: the #@ autocomplete item remap rewrites non-@ suggestion values to '#@<value>' (e.g. /cmd → '#@/cmd'), contradicting its own pass-through comment; applyCompletion does not depend on values starting with #@, so item-level pass-through is safe. BUG-005: URL_SHAPE_RE narrows the PRD URL spec's literal (https?|ftp) to https? only, and the coupled normalization site would mangle ftp:// tokens if only the regex changed — restore the spec-literal gate, sync the coupled site, and correct the spec's factually-wrong '(Node supports it)' claim.

tasks.title: BUG-004: Autocomplete item remap passes non-@ values through untouched

tasks.title: BUG-005: Restore spec-literal (https?|ftp) URL shape gate + sync coupled normalization + spec correction
tasks.description: Make code match the PRD URL spec's literal URL_SHAPE_RE ((https?|ftp)) — including the MANDATORY coupled fix to the https?-only normalization site that would otherwise mangle ftp:// tokens into https://ftp://… — and correct the spec's factually wrong '(Node supports it)' claim; ftp fetch still fails gracefully to verbatim via the existing catch.

subtasks.title: URL_SHAPE_RE ftp alternative + normalization site sync + spec/15 §7 correction
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Read plan/011_e473dac8178b/bugfix/001_a6ffb98ab096/architecture/spec_ux_bug004_005.md (§ BUG-005 spec-vs-code deviation + option comparison). spec/15-url-injection.md line 71 defines URL_SHAPE_RE with (https?|ftp); §7 edge-table row at line 325 promises ftp support but its parenthetical '(Node supports it)' is FACTUALLY WRONG — undici's fetch throws on ftp: (TypeError: fetch failed); §8 line 333 repeats the spec regex. Code: URL_SHAPE_RE at file-injector.ts:43 is (https?) only, JSDoc :27-43. COUPLED SITES: the shape gate at :1646; the normalization at :1660 '/^https?:\/\//i.test(tok) ? tok : "https://" + tok' — a REGEX-ONLY change would mangle '#ftp://example.com/x' into 'https://ftp://example.com/x' (NEW bug); the deny-list guard at :1656 is bypassed by ftp tokens anyway (they contain '/'); onUrlFetch fires at :1663 BEFORE fetch (honest: egress IS attempted); injectUrl's catch (:988-993) silently returns false → token stays verbatim.
2. INPUT: tok = cleanToken(m[2]) from the URL scan loop (URL_INJECT_RE matchAll); the spec-literal regex from spec/15 §2.2 line 71.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §Minor Issue 4 via the spec-literal option: (a) change URL_SHAPE_RE (:43) to /^((https?|ftp):\/\S+|(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,}(?::\d+)?(?:\/\S*)?)$/i; (b) MANDATORY: change the normalization test at :1660 to /^(https?|ftp):\/\//i so ftp tokens pass through un-prefixed; (c) update the JSDoc (:27-43) — drop the implicit narrowing, note that ftp:// passes the gate and fetch failure falls back to verbatim via the existing catch. Do NOT add an ftp client — the graceful verbatim path is the spec-consistent behavior. Failing test FIRST (label DET-FTP in url-injection.test.mjs near DET-2 :261-271, fetch stubbed in try/finally): globalThis.fetch = async (url) => { calls.push(String(url)); throw new TypeError("fetch failed"); } (simulating undici's real ftp behavior) → injectFiles("#ftp://example.com/x", [], FIX, false, true) → assert r.text === "#ftp://example.com/x" (verbatim), r.injected === 0, r.blocks.length === 0, calls.length === 1 && calls[0] === "ftp://example.com/x" (pins the no-mangling normalization — the critical regression net for the :1660 change). Keep COL-2 (:389-396, non-URL tokens → zero fetch) and DET-1/DET-2 green.
4. OUTPUT: URL_SHAPE_RE matches the PRD literal; ftp tokens attempt egress and fall back verbatim; no https://ftp:// mangling. URL_SHAPE_RE stays NOT exported (module-surface allowlist unchanged).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] (i) JSDoc on URL_SHAPE_RE per LOGIC (c); (ii) correct spec/15-url-injection.md §7 row line 325: replace 'fetch via fetch (Node supports it)' with the accurate statement that the gate accepts ftp:// but Node's fetch cannot retrieve it, so the token falls back to verbatim (spec §3.5 catch path); confirm §2.2 line 71 / §8 line 333 already match the restored regex. The README Limits bullet for this lands in P1.M4.T6 (changeset-level).
